deadline.value: The general fall deadline is July 21; some programs set earlier dates, and this page gives none.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is required of all engineering doctoral applicants, with 80th-percentile quantitative scores usually expected.
gre_general.quote: The GRE General section is required of all applicants. | Minimum scores at the 80th percentile on the Quantitative section and 3.5 on the Analytical Writing section are usually required depending on the specialization area.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE applies to engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE General section is required of all applicants.

supervisor.value: Admission comes first; an interim advisor is assigned in the specialization afterward.
supervisor.quote: When a student is admitted, an interim advisor is assigned in his/her specialization to assist the student in completing a preliminary study plan.

funding.value: The catalog says assistantships come from departments and research grants; it gives no share of funded students.
funding.quote: Teaching assistantships are provided by individual departments to provide assistance with classroom and laboratory courses.

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold a bachelor's or master's with at least one engineering degree; exceptions are possible.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for a doctorate in engineering should hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree with at least one degree in engineering | In exceptional cases, applicants may be considered without an engineering degree if they have a strong foundation in math and science.

toefl_min.value: Engineering requires a 78 iBT with at least 20 reading, 21 listening, 17 writing and 20 speaking.
toefl_min.quote: Note: The College of Engineering has higher TOEFL (iBT) subscore requirements: 78 (Reading: 20, Listening: 21, Writing: 17, Speaking: 20)

notes: One engineering PhD with specializations: Applied Biomedical Engineering, Chemical, Civil, Computer Science, Applied Data Science, Mechanical, Electrical and Computer Engineering. Recorded once under ece; CS and datasci have their own records.
name: Doctor of Philosophy in Engineering
